findings.note: Old (Nov 24, 2025), not current: Miller missed his second straight game, a home game against St. Louis, while day to day, and had only six assists in 22 games then. That's a weak assist rate and a history of missed time.

Old (Dec 2025): Miller scored the OT winner in a 2-1 win at St. Louis but had no assist. He was playing his usual top-six role and was on pace to finish below a point per game for the first time since 2020-21.
